AUTHOR: Garcia
TITLE: Automatic segmentation of fish using deep learning with application to fish size measurement
REGION: North Sea (R/V Dr Fridtjof Nansen, March 2017) and Norwegian Sea (M/S Vendla, May 2017)
SPECIES: Single 'fish' class; imagery includes saithe, blue whiting, redfish, Atlantic mackerel, velvet belly lanternshark, Norway pout, Atlantic herring
DATA: Own Deep Vision in-trawl stereo imagery from two cruises (dataset 1: 1605 annotated images from 3 hauls; dataset 2: 200 annotated images from 1 haul)
V_EV: Data acquisition: 'Lighting was provided by two synchronized strobes producing 18 000 lumen each at a colour of 4100 K.'
D2: Exp1: dataset 1 split 80/20 train/val, tested on dataset 2 (200 images, other cruise); Exp2: random 90% (80/20 train/val) / 10% test of pooled images
D_EV: Table 3 caption: 'results obtained by Mask R-CNN after training with randomly selected 90% images from dataset 1 (D#1) and dataset 2 (D#2), the other 10% is reserved for testing.'
R_EV: Results: 'training using the 1605 images of dataset 1, and then testing on the 200 annotated images of dataset 2, in which lighting conditions and camera settings have changed.'
C_EV: no statement found on a detection confidence threshold or uncertainty; FP only reported as error counts (Table 2: 'FN FP IoU*')
E_EV: Discussion: 'The validation of the size measurements is currently being pursuit with the intent of using fish specimens or accurate fish shape reproductions of known dimensions.'
ARCH: Mask R-CNN instance segmentation + gradient-based mask refinement + stereo skeleton/RANSAC length estimation; image linearisation and illumination compensation pre-processing
METR: IoU, pixel accuracy, proposed IoU* (per-fish, threshold 0.7), FN and FP counts
NOTE: In-trawl (pelagic trawl) imagery; ENV options do not fit open pelagic waters, coded NR. Two experiments: Exp1 = cross-cruise test (different cruise, sea, month, lighting angle, camera gain, species mix incl. krill) credited under R; within-dataset splits are random image splits (80/20, 90/10), so D1 coded as image random (verifier: D1 could alternatively be read as survey/cruise split for Exp1). R3=Y based on numeric comparison of Exp1 (IoU* 0.76/0.58) vs Exp2 pooled random test (0.89/0.79); Exp2 is pooled, not a pure dataset-1 in-domain test. IoU*>0.7 is an evaluation threshold, not a confidence threshold. Length is computed in the pipeline but no length results/validation reported, so E1=없음. E4=FNR because FN counts with totals are tabulated (counts, not rates). Camera-to-fish distance 'at least 20 cm' (V4=Y). 5 fps acquisition.
